title: Five Nights at Freddy's 1 Camera View (Interactive) (No longer maintained)
description:
**Please read this first!** https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2517518192/757304900494380406/


Warning: Minor flashing (from changing cameras)
Note: Doesn't support mobile!!
Lively version here: https://ko-fi.com/s/cac57714d5
Opera GX version here: https://store.gx.me/mods/74noji/five-nights-at-freddy-s-1/

FNAF 1 Camera Mechanic, recreated completely from the ground up so people can have an interactive FNAF 1 Camera on their desktop background!

Features:
-Interactive camera selection (just like in FNAF!)
-Background Audio (Can be changed via settings)
-Save last location checked upon wallpaper engine restart
-Animatronics that move and make noises!
-Random chance for animatronics (depending on their state and location) to sing/play music.
-Dynamic Time and night
-Hallucinations!
-A small easter egg
-Dynamic Power Percentage! (Based upon your laptops power, or remains at 100% otherwise)
-Camera Automatic Shuffle (Disabled by default, allows the wallpaper to shuffle between different cameras)
-No jumpscares!!!!!!! (Seriously, there's none. No. I am not adding them. Stop suggesting it.)
-Settings to disable light flicker, adjust camera static effect and camera flashes

Credits go to:
Scott Cawthon, for making this wonderful game series!

title: 音域回响
description:
Afdian Page: https://www.ifdian.net/a/CmzYa?utm_source=copylink&utm_medium=link
Your support keeps me updating this wallpaper!
Features
Audio Response — 160×160 grid bars pulse to music with real-time FFT frequency analysis
Ripple Effect — Ground ripples spread and bars bounce when low frequencies hit
Meteor Effect — Shooting stars fall on high frequencies, spawning particle explosions on impact
Idle Waves — Gentle breathing motion for bars when no audio is playing to keep the scene alive
10 Color Themes — Indigo Violet, Deep Sea Blue, Ice Blue, Emerald Green, Warm Gold, Amber Orange, Blood Red, Coral Pink, Neon Magenta, Minimal Black & White
Album Art — Supports Wallpaper Engine Media Integration; displays album cover, track title and artist with smooth transition animations
Player Controller — Floating frosted-glass panel with three size presets
Tunable Parameters — Render resolution, audio sensitivity, frequency range, camera view, rotation speed, ripple & meteor trigger sensitivity and intensity
Changelog
v15 — Optimized frequency distribution (primary response: 0–3.5kHz); refined render resolution range (80–320); anti-jitter for idle waves; fixed wallpaper config reload bugs; expanded spawn range for ripples and meteors; adjusted pulse trigger counter range (5–13)
v15 — Major performance improvements
v14 — Added render resolution setting; fixed response decay issue; idle-click meteor spawn
v13 — Album art transition animations; project size reduction; build optimizations
v12 — Media Integration support, built-in player UI
v11 — Idle wave system
v10 — Particle system & spring animations
v9 — Meteor effect + automatic beat detection
v8 — Ground ripple effect
v7 — 8-band FFT + tone metrics
v6 — 10 built-in color themes
v5 — Camera controls & shader optimizations
v4 — Wallpaper Engine audio integration
v3 — 160×160 instanced grid
v2 — Three.js 3D scene foundation
v1 — Initial Release
Tech Stack
React 19 · Three.js · React Three Fiber · Framer Motion · Tailwind CSS · GLSL Shaders
